purpose: Evidence packet only. ITA has a route-specific large-dog cabin service and must not be reduced to a global 8 kg rule. Icelandair's refusal below is only for international hold carriage. Royal Air Maroc's limits are pet plus container where stated.

provenance_defaults.reviewer: Codex — lecture directe de la page officielle

facts.condition_scope: the standard non-domestic ceiling is 8 kg including carrier and food; domestic flights have a different standard ceiling and a separate selected-route large-dog service
facts.finder_effect: On an international itinerary, a 30 or 32 kg dog is not eligible for the ordinary cabin-pet service. Do not apply this threshold to domestic ITA routes without the other ITA facts below.
facts.quote: up to 8 kg on all other flights.
facts.locator: Pets in the cabin → opening overview

facts.condition_scope: the domestic standard ceiling is 12 kg including carrier and food; it is distinct from the selected large-dog service
facts.finder_effect: A dog above 12 kg cannot be presented as eligible for ITA's ordinary domestic cabin-pet service.
facts.quote: animals weighing up to 12 kg on domestic flights (carrier and food included)
facts.locator: Pets in the cabin → opening overview

facts.condition_scope: Large Dog On Board is limited to selected domestic Large Dog flights, 30 kg dog body weight maximum, two dogs per flight and prior verification
facts.finder_effect: For a dog up to 30 kg, show this only as an ITA domestic-route lead with the explicit selection and confirmation conditions. A 32 kg dog does not qualify.
facts.quote: The service is only available for large dogs up to 30 kg on a selection of our domestic flights
facts.locator: Large Dog On Board → Flying together, even with your large dog

facts.condition_scope: only dogs and cats are permitted in the hold; capacity, carrier dimensions, departure/destination and advance booking apply
facts.finder_effect: Passenger hold may be proposed as conditional, never as confirmed until ITA validates the concrete booking.
facts.quote: pet transport is permitted only for dogs and cats, both in the cabin (PETC) and in the hold (AVIH).
facts.locator: Pets in the cabin → current provisions

facts.condition_scope: household dogs/cats require a pet agent and travel in the hold; Regional-operated itineraries are excluded and A321neo LR holds cannot carry live animals
facts.finder_effect: Hold may be proposed only where the operating aircraft and itinerary qualify, through the prescribed pet-agent process.
facts.quote: Pets must be booked to travel with a pet agent, and they will be carried in the aircraft hold.
facts.locator: Baggage Information → Carriage of Animals & Pets

facts.condition_scope: the published refusal is limited to international flights from 1 November 2024; it must not be applied to domestic carriage without a separate source
facts.finder_effect: On an international Icelandair itinerary, do not offer passenger hold for an ordinary pet dog from this rule.
facts.quote: we are unable to transport animals in the hold on international flights from November 1, 2024.

facts.condition_scope: official cabin limit is 8 kg including container; destination restrictions and advance declaration apply
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable. A dog under 8 kg still needs the container and route checks.
facts.quote: The animal must not weigh more than 8 kg including their container

facts.condition_scope: published passenger-hold rate bands run to 70 kg and connection/document conditions apply
facts.finder_effect: Passenger hold may be proposed conditionally below the stated maximum, with the actual crate, connection and acceptance conditions checked.
facts.quote: Passenger travelling with a pet in hold (AVIH): 47 to 70 KG
facts.locator: Travel with animals → Rates for transporting Animals

facts.condition_scope: the public animal-transport page states that above 70 kg the animal must travel as cargo
facts.finder_effect: Do not offer passenger hold above the stated 70 kg threshold; direct the visitor to freight conditions instead.
facts.quote: Por encima de ese peso, el animal debe ser transportado por carga.
facts.locator: Viajar con animales → Animales en la bodega

intentionally_unset.reason: The directly read source establishes the pet-agent hold process, but this cohort does not use it to infer an absolute ordinary-pet cabin refusal.
The source names a pet-agent process but does not establish a general cargo policy for the concrete dog and route.
No directly read current Icelandair source in this cohort establishes an ordinary pet-dog cabin policy.
The directly read current source establishes only the international passenger-hold refusal.
This cohort documents ITA passenger cabin and hold conditions, not a general positive cargo service.
The source gives the >70 kg direction to cargo but not a complete acceptance policy for the dog, crate and route.
